messages:
Maria (CSM): quick check — Aegis hosted commit vs actual for last week looks odd. saw a 3x spike Thu 23:40 UTC, flagged it. can someone grab the breakdown?
cost-bot: ALERT: hosted-usage anomaly detected for org=aegis | 2026-03-19T23:35 — tokens=3,200,000 (baseline 1.0M) | severity=warning | link: https://redwood.app/dash/aegis-usage
Samir (Billing): pulling the commit reconciliation now. initial glance: spike ~2.1M extra tokens between 23:20–00:10. CSV export: https://redwood.app/exports/aegis/2026-03-19.csv
Samir (Billing): commit for Aegis is 50M/mo, their weekly burn usually ~9–11M. this one pushed their projected month to ~56M if it repeats.
Oliver (Eng): tagging in case of infra loop/backfill — no retry storms in infra logs. ran query `SELECT event_type, count(*) FROM api_requests WHERE org='aegis' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-19T23:00' AND '2026-03-20T00:30' GROUP BY event_type;` results show 70% text.generate with avg seq_len ~1,900 tokens.
Tess (Aegis): @Maria sorry — we kicked off a late-night data-augmentation job that calls the hosted API in parallel (new internal job). i thought it used our dedicated capacity but it hit hosted by mistake. we paused it at 00:05.
Maria (CSM): thanks for the context @Tess. ok — so this looks like customer-triggered burst, not a platform bug. need to confirm whether this fits their commit or requires one-off credit/adjustment.
Samir (Billing): if it's a one-off and they paused quickly, we can absorb under tolerance. but it pushed them over the weekly safe band. proposing: 1) apply a one-time credit for the overshoot 2) educate on Dedicated vs Hosted routing 3) add guardrails in billing alerts.
Nora (Product): +1 on guardrails. we should also suggest a quick config change: add `X-Route-Preference: dedicated` header or use the SDK option `route: dedicated` to avoid hitting hosted next time. can we include that in enablement doc?
Oliver (Eng): sending a small snippet to share with Tess:
```
// ensure requests route to dedicated
client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, route: 'dedicated' })
```
Maria (CSM): Tess — would you like a short enablement session tomorrow to walk through the routing and cost-safeguards? also want to confirm renewal impact — this was an accidental spike but makes their monthly projection nudge above commit.
Tess (Aegis): yes please, tomorrow works. we want to avoid surprises for our finance team. appreciate the credit offer if that's an option.
Samir (Billing): I'll draft a credit note for the overshoot and mark it as discretionary (one-time). cc @Maria for approval.
Maria (CSM): approve the discretionary credit. i'll include a renewal risk note in the account doc: accidental overages may raise concern with finance but we have enablement + credit which should mitigate.
Nora (Product): i'll add a short enablement blurb to the onboarding guide and a checklist item for routed jobs.
Oliver (Eng): captured a follow-up task: add a backend metric to detect sudden shift in avg seq_len per-org and alert at 2x baseline. filing ticket INF-4719.
Maria (CSM): action items: Samir -> credit + billing note; Oliver -> metric ticket; Nora -> onboarding blurb; Tess -> confirm paused job and share job config. sched 30m enablement tomorrow 15:00 PT. closing this thread, will follow up in account doc. :raised_hands:
